Cross-head tests found opposing layer-11 head-2/3 output geometry shared by both checkpoints. Components are heuristic inspection priorities. A is an arbitrary forced tie-break at probability 0.5.

weights_only_4.evidence: Thirty weight-only runs identify distributed late numerical changes and selective attenuation in B of user-associated numerical kernels involving L1H2 and later heads. Selected user-kernel norms decrease about 17-29%, versus about 1-4% for model-associated kernels. Several algebraic and shuffle controls support connection specificity, but the early routing check did not establish that role tokens supply these paths during actual computation. No analysis distinguished selection of the guessed answer from question information. B is a subjective 55% guess; component ordering is a structural shortlist, not a verified causal ranking.
